document.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
document.summary: Overview shows a compact Look for owner index with counts and jumps. Group pages keep the full claim list. Sources jump to a pin, a citing claim, or the named group.
document.why: [#71](source:s1) wants document and group lookFor, plus related sources, easy to scan and jump from in the fixed UI.

sources.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
sources.gist: Make lookFor and sources a scan-and-jump surface. Do not store pass/fail. Do not host forge comments.

sources.label: PR #76
sources.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
sources.gist: Implements the lookFor and sources lanes, then a compact Overview index.

sources.label: Cursor session · Sep 13
sources.gist: Leave skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md unchanged unless the issue requires it.

sources.label: Cursor session · Overview dump
sources.gist: Keep the cleaner lookFor UI on groups. Do not dump every lookFor on Overview.

lookFor: [#71](source:s1) forbids storing pass/fail on lookFor. LookForClaim has no status field, and LookForList has no checkbox.
[#71](source:s1) asks to list claims and jump to the owner. Overview LookForIndex shows counts and owner jumps, not every claim sentence.
[The later feedback](source:s4) says Overview must not dump every lookFor. Document claims sit in a closed details row.
[#71](source:s1) puts hosting forge review comments out of scope. This diff does not add a comment host or a sync.
[The first follow-up](source:s3) says leave SKILL.md alone. This diff does not edit skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md.

groups.title: Claim list without a grade
groups.why: [#71](source:s1) needs a list of claims to scan. The list is not a checkbox grade.
groups.summary: `lookForClaims` walks document then group bullets, parses risk tags, and buckets them by owner.
lookFor: LookForClaim has key, owner, tag, text, body, and sourceIds. It has no passed, failed, or checked field.

groups.title: Look for lane
groups.why: [#71](source:s1) wants a place to scan and jump. [The later feedback](source:s4) says Overview must not dump every claim.
groups.summary: `LookForIndex` on Overview is counts and owner jumps. `LookForList` on GroupBrief is the full sentences.
lookFor: LookForIndex renders one row per owner. Group claim sentences stay off Overview until you open that group.
The document bucket is a closed details. Opening it renders LookForList for those claims only.
The focused row sets aria-current to location. It does not set aria-checked.

groups.title: Sources jump
groups.why: [#71](source:s1) also wants related sources easy to jump from, without hosting forge comments.
groups.summary: SourceList gist clicks call onOpenSource. A label with a url still opens that url.
lookFor: openTargetForSource prefers a line pin, then the first citing lookFor, then group.sources, then Overview.

groups.title: Focus and stack counts
groups.why: A jump has to land on a claim. The stack should show that claims exist before you open Overview.
groups.summary: `App` stores focusLookForKey, and Sidebar prints Look for counts on Overview and on groups that have bullets.
lookFor: selectFromNav clears focusLookForKey. openLookFor sets it, then selectWithMotion.
Sidebar shows Look for · N only when the count is greater than 0.

commits.subject: Keep Overview lookFor as a compact owner index.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Group pages still list the full claims. Overview shows counts and jump links, with whole-change claims behind a closed details row.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Drop strand dots from lookFor owners.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
The mixed-review dots sat next to source marks and read as bullets. The owner label is enough to jump.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>

commits.subject: Surface lookFor and sources as scan-and-jump lanes.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Overview lists every document and group lookFor claim with its owner and source marks. Opening a claim goes to that group or stays on Overview. Sources jump to the first citing claim, line pin, or named group. Claims stay claims: no pass/fail state.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
